No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you study medieval drainage, water control and city defence.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Public Satpula viewpoint
  • Visible arched openings
  • Jahanpanah topography
  • Wrap-up

How the time is spent

  1. Public Satpula viewpoint 15 min

    Introduce dam/barrage and seasonal waterways.

    You: sketch hydraulic system

  2. Visible arched openings 20 min

    Discuss movement/control of water.

    You: count visible arches cautiously

  3. Jahanpanah topography 25 min

    Link city defence and ecology.

    You: draw contours

  4. Wrap-up 15 min

    Discuss changing drainage and urban growth.

    You: design water lesson

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Satpula Waterworks using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study medieval drainage, water control and city defence.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.
